_comment: Release notes for 1.1.7 (versionCode 10, 2026-11-22). Same locale keys as 03e-03g. Landscape no longer a required hardware feature (devices dropped in 1.1.6 come back).

notes.en:
Film Camela 1.1.7
• Available on more phones and tablets
• Small fixes for the new landscape camera
